summary: Advises keeping Ansible content simple and using advanced features only when needed, for example not combining vars, vars_files, vars_prompt and extra vars with external inventory.
questions: What is a best practice for structuring Ansible playbooks?
Should I use all the different ways to define variables at once?

answer_card.title: Keep automation simple
answer_card.answer_md: Use advanced features only when you need them and pick the one that fits. You likely don't need `vars`, `vars_files`, `vars_prompt` and `--extra-vars` all at once alongside an external inventory. If something feels complicated, look for a simpler approach.
